limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not run.
Power-up state is unspecified and is not assigned an invented initial value.
No synthesis or board verification performed.
interface_cycle_contract: TopModule(clk, reset, q[3:0]); positive-edge counter from 1 through 10 inclusive, wrapping to 1; synchronous active-high reset to 1.
numeric_width_decisions: Four-bit unsigned output and explicitly sized four-bit constants.
pipeline: Output updates on each rising clock edge; no extra latency.
static_review: Single always_ff driver, nonblocking assignments, correct reset priority and wrap boundary.
